verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI palette can summarize meeting notes, list action items/key takeaways, answer custom prompts, and chat with filtered notes using GPT-4o/Claude 3.5 Sonnet, which is genuine in-product AI-generated insight generation. However, this is largely on-demand prompt-based assistance rather than proactive/autonomous insight surfacing, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of quality or accuracy. missing for 10: proactive/autonomous insight suggestions (not just user-triggered), independent hands-on verification of AI output quality, and evidence of deeper agentic behavior beyond chat/summarization.
